description:
Connect your Apple Search Ads data to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to track spend, measure installs, and see which keywords are driving App Store downloads.

Compare impressions, taps, tap-through rate, cost per tap, installs, and cost per install across date ranges. Break results down by campaign, ad group, keyword, or storefront. Turn your app advertising data into clear reports and spot where budget is working.

interface.longDescription:
Connect your Apple Search Ads data to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to track spend, measure installs, and see which keywords are driving App Store downloads.

Compare impressions, taps, tap-through rate, cost per tap, installs, and cost per install across date ranges. Break results down by campaign, ad group, keyword, or storefront. Turn your app advertising data into clear reports and spot where budget is working.
interface.shortDescription: Talk to your Apple Ads data

publication.release_notes: Explore Apple Ads spend, taps, installs, and campaign performance. Find your top keywords and compare results across reporting periods.

prompts: How much did we spend on Apple Ads in the 30 days ending two days ago in Apple Ads Demo?
Show spend, impressions, taps, and tap-through installs for each Apple Ads campaign in the 30 days ending two days ago in Apple Ads Demo.
How many total Apple Ads installs did we get in the 30 days ending two days ago in Apple Ads Demo, split into new downloads and redownloads?
Which five Apple Ads keywords generated the most tap-through installs in the 30 days ending two days ago in Apple Ads Demo? Include their spend and taps.
Compare Apple Ads spend and total installs in Apple Ads Demo for the 30 days ending two days ago with the preceding 30 days.

positive.description: Total ad spend. Use a fresh Data Mode conversation with reviewer access to workspace Apple Ads Demo and its connected goPuff - UK account. Let D be the current date in the user's timezone. Use [D-31, D-2] for the recent 30 days and [D-61, D-32] for the preceding 30 days, both inclusive. Recalculate dates at review time. Use returned data for expected numbers; never reuse preparation observations as answers. These numerical cases require report rows. If the response is empty, verify the account and reporting period before marking the numerical scenario passed.
positive.prompt: How much did we spend on Apple Ads in the 30 days ending two days ago in Apple Ads Demo?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workspace and choose workspace_name=Apple Ads Demo. Discover exact fields using list_metrics_and_breakdowns_apple_ads, then call retrieve_reporting_data with only necessary fields in assorted_requests.apple_ads_request. Do not call preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode. Do not send client_id, reporting_mode, conversation history or unrelated context. Read model-visible reportingData.AppleAds.data, table names, headers, date segments and note_of_assumption. Match columns by header. Show actual dates. Keep returned currencies separate and preserve numeric precision until display rounding. Installs means tap-through installs; Total installs includes tap-through and view-through installs. Label the scope correctly. Do not turn empty data or errors into zero activity, fabricate results, or reuse historical expected answers. Request metrics=[Cost], breakdowns=[Account ID, Account name, Account currency]. Use date_ranges=[[D-31, D-2]] and no time_granularity. Read Account and show total Cost for the returned account and currency. Cost is already in currency units; do not divide it by one million or interpret it as a budget. Round the final money display to two decimals while retaining the underlying precision for comparisons.

Discover exact fields using list_metrics_and_breakdowns_apple_ads, then call retrieve_reporting_data with only necessary fields in assorted_requests.apple_ads_request. If the response is truncated, label the ranking as limited to returned rows.

Discover exact fields using list_metrics_and_breakdowns_apple_ads, then call retrieve_reporting_data with only necessary fields in assorted_requests.apple_ads_request. negative.description: Campaign editing is unsupported. Explain that this plugin retrieves reports and cannot pause campaigns or change budgets. Do not invoke reporting, catalog, workspace, preview or preference tools as a substitute, and do not claim a campaign changed.
negative.prompt: Pause all Apple Ads campaigns in Apple Ads Demo and halve their daily budgets.

negative.description: Creating keywords or setting bids is unsupported. Explain that the reporting plugin cannot create the keyword or set its bid. Do not call reporting tools to simulate the action or claim it succeeded.
negative.prompt: Add the keyword grocery delivery to our Apple Ads campaigns in Apple Ads Demo and set its bid to 2 GBP.

negative.description: Access is limited to connected authorized accounts. Explain that an unconnected competitor account cannot be queried without authorized access. Do not substitute demo data, request a competitor password or fabricate their spend.
negative.prompt: Show private Apple Ads spend for a competitor account that is not connected to our workspace.
